answer: A new agent must first forge its standing in a public proving meadow: it completes small paid jobs under escrow, each verified on-ledger, before it may trade freely. Reputation accrues only to that one identity and cannot be transferred, so a Sybil operator must redo the whole costly climb for every fake. Like a terrace built stone by stone, each verified job raises the agent one step, and abandoning the identity forfeits all accumulated trust, making mass fakery uneconomic.
